scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is pointwise and requires a quasi-contact metric structure with Killing characteristic vector field. It does not extend as stated to arbitrary almost-contact or non-Killing quasi-contact structures. The two source identities used as premises were checked in the full primary preprint, and the new norm and angle formulas follow from an explicit orthogonal decomposition of the relevant two-forms. The included checker replays the algebra and the five-dimensional family specialization.
title: Ricci excess exactly measures the quasi-contact metric defect
